class: Any non-terminal state of a lifecycle (strategy, order, proposal) from which every action the system offers is refused leaves the user stuck with no path forward except acting outside the platform; the explanation shown for that state then points at actions that do not work. A transition table checked only pair-by-pair (is each allowed move allowed?) cannot see this: it needs a reachability check that every reachable non-terminal state has at least one action that succeeds.
mechanism: W-041 strategy state machine: the transition table matched the spec exactly (31 pairs), but guards on the underlying record (version store) refused every offered action in some reachable states.

first_seen.evidence: probe P3c: Partially Executed -> Reconciliation Required -> manual adopt returned to Partially Executed with version 2 active; Complete/Retry refused 'version 1 is no longer pending', Close refused 'the broker still holds a position'; explain() still offered all four choices

detection.note: Needed: a reachability test that walks every reachable (state, record) combination and asserts at least one offered action succeeds, and that explain() offers only actions that succeed.
